name: Down-Shifts Do Not Create Shattered Coordinate Sets
statement: For every Boolean class $H$ and coordinate $x$, elementary down-shifting satisfies $\operatorname{str}(D_xH)\subseteq\operatorname{str}(H)$. In particular $\operatorname{VCdim}(D_xH)\le\operatorname{VCdim}(H)$.
proof: A shattered set omitting $x$ has the same trace before and after the shift. If a shifted class shatters a set containing $x$, each upper-fiber concept realizing a trace survived only because its matching lower concept was present before shifting; the surviving concepts and their lower mates already realize every trace in the original class.
